metadata.title: Why a 'Stationary' Quantum State Is Actually Spinning
metadata.thing: a clock hand spinning in the complex plane while its squared length holds still
metadata.color_notes: Spinning hand + tip + traced circle = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. Re/Im projections = ghost grey. Steady probability bar = ink outline; the closing 'spinning underneath' emphasis = red #C0392B.

beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a small friendly bear, full body, standing, looking up with curiosity]

beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Physicists call an energy eigenstate 'stationary' because nothing you can measure about it ever changes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Physicists call an energy eigenstate 'stationary' because nothing you can measure about it ever changes.
beats.new_visual_element: a person staring at a perfectly still, frozen object
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person calmly staring at a small object floating perfectly still]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person nodding at the motionless floating object]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and a motionless floating object draw in; nothing about the object moves; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: But peek underneath, and the wave function is spinning the entire time.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But peek underneath, and the wave function is spinning the entire time.
beats.new_visual_element: the person lifting a cover to reveal a spinning clock hand
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person lifting a cover off an object to peek underneath]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person surprised to find a spinning clock hand under the cover]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person lifts a cover to reveal a spinning clock hand whirring underneath; surprise; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: The wave function lives in the complex plane: a real axis and an imaginary one.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The wave function lives in the complex plane: a real axis and an imaginary one.
beats.new_visual_element: an Argand plane with Re (horizontal) and Im (vertical) axes
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a complex plane on the left with a horizontal 'Re' axis and a vertical 'Im' axis

beats.narration_text: An energy eigenstate is an arrow in that plane — a clock hand.
beats.tts_normalized_text: An energy eigenstate is an arrow in that plane — a clock hand.
beats.new_visual_element: a fixed-length arrow (clock hand) from the origin, tip dot
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw an arrow from the origin to a point on a circle — the clock hand — with a dot at its tip

beats.narration_text: It spins steadily, at a rate set entirely by its energy.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It spins steadily, at a rate set entirely by its energy.
beats.new_visual_element: the hand begins rotating at a constant rate
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: start the hand rotating continuously at a constant angular rate (ValueTracker on the angle)

beats.narration_text: Its real and imaginary parts oscillate ninety degrees apart, like the shadow of a turning hand.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Its real and imaginary parts oscillate ninety degrees apart, like the shadow of a turning hand.
beats.new_visual_element: dashed projections onto the Re and Im axes that oscillate as it spins
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: drop dashed projection lines from the tip onto the Re and Im axes; they slide back and forth as the hand turns

beats.narration_text: But the hand's length never changes — the tip just traces a circle.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But the hand's length never changes — the tip just traces a circle.
beats.new_visual_element: the traced circle highlighted; length is constant
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: highlight the dashed circle the tip traces; indicate the constant radius

beats.narration_text: Probability is that length squared — and squaring throws the spinning angle away.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Probability is that length squared — and squaring throws the spinning angle away.
beats.new_visual_element: a steady probability bar appears on the right, |psi|^2
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: on the right, raise a steady bar labelled |psi|^2 whose height is the squared length; it does not move

beats.narration_text: So the hand whirls on the left while the only thing you can observe sits frozen on the right.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the hand whirls on the left while the only thing you can observe sits frozen on the right.
beats.new_visual_element: 'spinning' tag on the hand, 'frozen' tag on the bar
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: tag the left panel 'spinning' and the right panel 'frozen' while motion continues

beats.narration_text: That's the trick of the word: stationary on the outside, spinning underneath.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That's the trick of the word: stationary on the outside, spinning underneath.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the scene and write a red label 'stationary outside, spinning underneath'; clean close
